plotEn:
A public service announcement screen from the FBI states that the following footage was recovered from bodycams and security cameras at Wilshire Infirmary in 2023. 
Recently discharged ex-Marine Edward Yoon begins his first night shift as a security guard at an abandoned psychiatric hospital. The only other people in the building are Lester Wooley, a cynical former cop who acts as the senior security guard and Edward's boss, and Ms Downey, a kindly administrator who exhibits strange, catatonic behaviour when Edward leaves her office. 
During a tour of the building, Lester locks Edward inside a mortuary refrigerator with a bloodied mannequin head as a hazing ritual. Lester explains the dark history of the hospital, including rumours of cruel medical experimentation on patients. He also shows Edward several patient documents, explaining that the patients don't care about privacy because they're all dead.
Upon returning to the surveillance room, the two men notice an intruder, who Lester refers to as a "tweaker" on the security monitors. Lester confronts the intruder over the tannoy system, causing her to panic and destroy the security camera. Lester and Edward set out to find her. During the search, they pass a dark corridor, which Lester instructs Edward to avoid at all costs. Eventually, they conclude that the intruder has fled through a broken window and return to the surveillance room again. 
A power outage causes Lester to head to the basement to flip the breaker switch. H
